data.description: A stunning collection of villas and townhouses in the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates.

data.answer: The community will showcase 84 exquisite residences, thoughtfully designed to provide a blend of luxury and comfort. These family-friendly villas in Jumeirah Golf Estates will feature a host of upscale amenities, creating an ideal environment for families to thrive. Set in a tranquil location, this exclusive neighborhood will offer a peaceful lifestyle, away from the hustle and bustle of the city, while still being connected to all essential conveniences.

Want to experience luxury living in Terra Golf Collection Dubai, the properties here feature an exclusive selection of villas, twin villas, and townhouses with breathtaking views of the golf course. Each residence is meticulously crafted to provide a bespoke living experience, complete with high-end amenities such as a sky lounge, private backyard, theatre room, and personal gym. 

The Terra Golf Collection at Jumeirah Golf Estates offers a variety of exquisitely designed residences, with covered areas ranging from 4,684 sq. ft. to 8,034 sq. ft., perfectly suited for those seeking family-friendly villas in Jumeirah Golf Estates. These homes cater to modern lifestyles with expansive layouts and premium amenities, ensuring comfort and convenience for families of all sizes. 

Standalone Villas

Standalone villas are crafted to perfection, featuring a basement and two levels above ground. The ground floor includes a spacious living area, modern kitchen, private garden, and pool, while the first floor is dedicated to bedrooms for maximum privacy. The top level boasts a terrace and a luxurious sky lounge with a private bar and Jacuzzi, making it ideal for relaxation and entertaining. This attention to detail exemplifies the development’s appeal, answering the question of why invest in Terra Golf Collection Jumeirah Golf Estates with a clear commitment to excellence.

Twin Villas

Twin villas offer a similar sense of grandeur, featuring a basement, ground floor, and two additional levels. The ground floor includes an open kitchen, a large living area, a guest bedroom with an attached bathroom, and a maid’s room, making them ideal for families. The first floor houses the en-suite master bedroom, a family lounge, and two additional bedrooms, while the top floor features a terrace, powder room, and two more bedrooms. These homes are complete with private parking, a Jacuzzi, and a pool, underscoring their position as prime family-friendly villas in Jumeirah Golf Estates.

Townhouses

Townhouses in the Terra Golf Collection offer a thoughtfully designed G+2 layout, perfectly suited for smaller families or those seeking a more compact luxury living experience. The ground floor includes a spacious living area with doors opening to a private garden and pool. The first floor features a master bedroom with a dressing room, en-suite bathroom, and balcony, while the second floor includes a terrace and a pantry for added convenience. This well-rounded design, coupled with the serene environment of Jumeirah Golf Estates, showcases why investing in Terra Golf Collection Jumeirah Golf Estates is an exceptional choice for families and investors alike.

Buying a Property in Terra Golf Collection

With prices starting at approximately AED 7.2M, owning a home in Terra Golf Collection is both luxurious and accessible through flexible payment plans. Buyers can secure their property by paying 60% during the construction phase and the remaining 40% upon handover, making it a seamless and convenient investment opportunity.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in the Terra Golf Collection?

data.answer:
Life in the Terra Golf Collection offers a perfect blend of luxury, tranquility, and exclusivity, surrounded by lush golf course views. With state-of-the-art amenities and a serene environment, it’s an ideal retreat for families and individuals seeking a refined lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Terra Golf Collection

As the community is still under development, there are no public transportation options available within the neighborhood. However, the nearest metro station is Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station, located within a short 14-minute drive.

Another nearby public transport available is Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station 2 which is a 15-minute drive from Terra Golf Collection via Sheikh Zayed Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E11).

As for the parking, every home in Terra Golf Collection will feature dedicated parking spaces for vehicles.

Supermarkets Around Terra Golf Collection

The nearest supermarket to the community is Spinneys. It is located in the master Jumeirah Golf Estates community and is only 5-minute drive.

Schools and Nurseries Near Terra Golf Collection

Families living in Terra Golf Collection will have access to excellent educational options nearby. Dibber Nurseries, located approximately 10 minutes away near Orange Lake in Jumeirah Golf Estates, provides a nurturing environment with an interactive learning approach based on the Norwegian curriculum, making it ideal for young learners. 

For older children, Victory Heights Primary School in Dubai Sports City is about a 15-minute drive and offers a high standard of education following the UK curriculum up to Year 6.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Terra Golf Collection

Residents of Terra Golf Collection have access to a range of healthcare facilities within close proximity. NMC Royal Hospital in Dubai Investment Park, located approximately 10 minutes away, is the nearest hospital offering comprehensive medical services.

For outpatient care, the GMC Clinic in the neighboring Green Community is about a 12-minute drive. Additionally, Medicentres in Motor City, just 15 minutes away, and Your Health Clinic in Dubai Sports City, only 10 minutes from the community, provide convenient healthcare options for residents.

Location & Nearby Areas

Terra Golf Collection is perfectly positioned within the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates. Its strategic location places it near several vibrant neighborhoods, each offering unique features and lifestyles, adding to the appeal of this exclusive development.

Dubai Sports City, located just 7.9 km away, is a dynamic community centered around sports and fitness, with state-of-the-art stadiums, academies, and a variety of residential options. 

Similarly, Production Dubai City, situated about 8.3 km from Terra Golf Collection, serves as a hub for media production and business, offering a blend of commercial and residential properties, making it a versatile destination for professionals and families alike.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Terra Golf Collection

data.answer:
At Terra Golf Collection, residents can enjoy serene golf course views, private outdoor spaces, and luxurious amenities like sky lounges and pools.

Beaches Near Terra Golf Collection

For a day by the sea, residents of Terra Golf Collection can head to JBR Beach, which is approximately a 25-minute drive away. Another popular option is Kite Beach, known for its vibrant atmosphere and water sports, located about 30 minutes from the community.

Hotels Around Terra Golf Collection

Residents and visitors of Terra Golf Collection have access to several luxury hotels in the vicinity. The Radisson Dubai DAMAC Hills is approximately a 10-minute drive away, offering comfortable accommodations and modern amenities.

For a more upscale experience, the FIVE Jumeirah Village is about 15 minutes away, featuring stylish rooms and vibrant dining options.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Terra Golf Collection will offer a wide range of facilities to cater to outdoor activities, fitness, and relaxation. Once completed, the community will feature a fully equipped gym, a dedicated kids' play area, lush parks and leisure spaces, and a luxurious swimming pool. 

These amenities are designed to provide residents with a balanced lifestyle, combining wellness, recreation, and family-friendly spaces in a serene environment.

Community Events

The neighborhood will host a variety of community events, fostering a vibrant and connected neighborhood. From family-friendly gatherings to seasonal celebrations, these events will enhance the sense of community and provide opportunities for social interaction.

Attractions and Landmarks

Al Maktoum International Airport is conveniently reachable within 30 minutes, ensuring effortless travel for frequent flyers. For sports enthusiasts, the Dubai International Cricket Stadium is just a short 13-minute drive, making it an ideal spot to catch live matches and events.

This exclusive development promises a luxurious lifestyle with top-tier amenities and thoughtfully designed homes. Its strategic location ensures seamless access to nearby attractions, schools, and leisure hubs, offering both convenience and elegance for residents and investors.

What types of properties are available in Terra Golf Collection?

Terra Golf Collection offers a mix of standalone villas, twin villas, and townhouses with luxurious amenities and spacious layouts.

Where is the Terra Golf Collection located?

It is situated within the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates, a prime location renowned for its tranquil environment and golf course views.

What is the expected handover date for Terra Golf Collection?

The project is scheduled for completion and handover by Q2 2027.

What amenities will be available in the community?

The development will feature a gym, swimming pool, kids’ play areas, parks, and leisure spaces, along with private backyards and terraces for select residences.

How can I purchase a property in Terra Golf Collection?

Properties can be secured with flexible payment plans, requiring 60% during construction and 40% upon handover. Prices start from AED 7.2 million.

Each residence combines privacy and elegance, making it the perfect choice for families seeking a refined way of life in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities. Situated within the heart of Jumeirah Golf Estates, the Terra Golf Collection provides a seamless blend of sophistication and tranquility. 

Scheduled for handover in Q2 2027, the Terra Golf Collection project promises a unique living experience that reflects the unparalleled prestige of Jumeirah Golf Estates. With its spacious layouts, luxurious finishes, and integration with nature, these 6-bedroom villas set a new benchmark for excellence in Dubai’s property market. Whether you are looking for a family home or an investment opportunity, this off-plan project exemplifies modern luxury within a secure, gated setting.
